view.render.doc: Send a fresh frame of a view.

view.results.doc: A page of the filter result list, grouped by visible block.

view.reveal.doc: Select a block and navigate until it is drawn (W3 click).

view.select.doc: Select a block (or clear the selection).

view.set.doc: Change detail, viewport, switches, colour or filter mode.

view.tag.doc: Tag the selection (Ctrl+1..4) or clear tags (Ctrl+0).

view.up.doc: Zoom to the parent; the folder left is selected.

visual.list.doc: Visualizations this server offers and whether this session can show each.

volume.list.doc: Volumes offered on the start page (W1).
